title: loopzero-admission-policies values
description: Schema for loopzero-admission-policies — the ValidatingAdmissionPolicies, the sigstore ClusterImagePolicy and their alerts. One chart for every install: ArgoCD consumes it as the published OCI chart, and Helmfile L2 installs it on the core cluster (admission-policies-mgmt) and on every cell (admission-policies). A B16-class misconfiguration (policy-controller deny-by-default with no matching ClusterImagePolicy) rejects every tenant pod cluster-wide, so the shapes below fail fast.

docrPrefix.description: DOCR registry prefix. MUST end with '/' and contain no whitespace: the anchored pattern catches 'registry with space/', which an unanchored '/$' accepted (2026-05-20). Used as a string-prefix match in the restrict-registries VAP, so an empty or malformed prefix is the B16 bug class.

additionalPrefixes.description: Opt-in additional registry prefixes accepted by the restrict-registries VAP. Empty by default (production allows only docrPrefix); local installs add k3d-loopzero-registry:5000/ for locally built images.

vaps.description: Per-policy toggles. Each is an explicit boolean — no defaulting through Helm null coalescing.

mode.description: warn = log and admit; enforce = reject unsigned images. An install flips it per environment (Helmfile sets it from the environment's policyMode); the `clusterimagepolicy-mode` gate requires a recorded sign-off for the chart default to be enforce.

imageGlobs.description: At least one image glob: a policy that matches nothing guards nothing.

clusterImagePolicyKeyless.description: INF-G16 + MEET-2026-05-03-063 — keyless cosign via Fulcio + Rekor

fulcioURL.description: Fulcio certificate authority URL. A pattern, not format:uri, which default JSON-schema validators accept silently (2026-05-20).

rekorURL.description: Rekor transparency log URL. Pattern-based for the same reason as fulcioURL.

oidcIssuer.description: OIDC issuer URL — the BUILD cluster's external OIDC URL, never the intra-cluster one, which breaks cross-cluster verification. Empty by default; the template fails the render when the keyless policy is enabled without it.

identityRegexp.description: Identity regex. MUST narrowly scope to the expected OIDC subjects and be anchored ^...$ (a prefix match admits system:serviceaccount:argo:loopzero-build-sa-malicious).

alerts.description: PrometheusRule toggles for policy-controller, tenant-namespace and (behind sigstoreEnabled) the sigstore alerts.

sigstoreEnabled.description: Renders the sigstore and sigstore-storage PrometheusRules and the TUF-expiry CronJob. Off until the sigstore stack runs in the target cluster.

systemActorExemptions.description: Identities no admission policy may block (templates/_helpers.tpl loopzero-admission.systemActorExemptions). ServiceAccount names in loopzero-system. At least two, or the negated `in` list denies the platform's own controllers (EC-2).
